audit.title: LocalFlow V2 — M12 Read-Only Deep Audit

D01.title: Note-bound dictation authority after PTT
D01.decision: The PTT binding captures the note id, the caret as a code-point anchor from the one validated UTF-16 conversion, and a hash of the note text before the anchor. Delivery requires the same note open in the editor AND the text before the anchor unchanged; then the result is inserted at the anchor. Edits after the anchor keep the authority (the dictation lands before them); an edit before the anchor, a different note, a closed editor or an unreadable native range remove it. A nonzero selection anchors at its start and is never replaced. Switching away and back keeps the authority while the prefix is unchanged. A refusal is a retained saved_not_inserted result (History keeps the text; nothing is written to the clipboard).
expected: edit before anchor -> saved_not_inserted/note_changed_during_dictation, note unchanged, pasteboard count unchanged
edit after anchor -> inserted at the anchor, confirmed after commit
switch away and back, prefix unchanged -> inserted, confirmed
closed/deleted note -> saved_not_inserted, no resurrection, no clipboard
selection (1,2) in 'A😀B' -> anchor 1, 'AX😀B'
two jobs anchored at 10 and 20, B finishing first -> both inserted at their anchors, one revision per job

D02.title: Restore linearization
D02.decision: Restore first saves the editor buffer through the generation current at the click (a bounded barrier that waits for a save already in progress). When that save completes, the restore copies the old content forward on top of the writer-current revision. When it does not (failed, unknown, or still pending at the bound), the restore is refused with that reason and the buffer is kept and retried. already_flushing is never returned to a durable action.
expected: save then restore -> chain ends typed(buffer), restore(old) with parent = the typed revision
restore while an autosave is held past the bound -> 'restore not done', no restore revision, buffer committed when the save completes

D03.title: Two attributed arrivals
D03.decision: Every attributed arrival is an immutable record (preimage, content, provenance, generation) captured under the same lock as the buffer change and committed as its own revision; typed text an arrival landed in is committed first as a typed revision. The historical 'second arrival wins the slot' limitation is repaired, not grandfathered.
expected: dictation A then transform B before any save -> revisions dictated(A) then transform(B); spans resolve to exactly A's and B's words
a failed A attempt never overwrites B's identity

D04.title: Whitespace-word spans
D04.decision: Spans are half-open whitespace-split word ranges (str.split semantics, including NBSP and other Unicode whitespace). An arrival's span covers only the words lying wholly inside its characters: a word merging typed and dictated characters is not attributed (the mid-word case abstains). A rebase whose covered word sequence changes its occurrence count or rank is ambiguous and abstains. Grapheme clusters and linguistic tokens are not modelled.
expected: 'typed one a ' + 'D' at 12 -> dictated words ['D']
'echo echo' deleting the dictated first -> no dictated span
CJK run is one word; ZWJ emoji sequence is one word per whitespace run

D05.title: Revision growth
D05.decision: Unchanged: every save stores full content; no coalescing or retention pass; no schema migration (the store stays at v11). The versions list stays bounded at 200 with the truncated flag.
expected: 201 revisions -> 200 headers + versions_truncated

D06.title: Export publication and managed-copy boundary
D06.decision: The file chosen in the save panel is the one approved for replacement: it is written as a private temporary file beside it and renamed into place last (a symlink there is replaced as a link, its target untouched). Attachment copies are created exclusively (O_EXCL, no-follow) under the first free name stem-NN[-k].ext and never overwrite an existing file. Only attachments referenced by a marker in the exported content are copied; a live attachment without a marker is counted as unreferenced_attachments. Any failure removes exactly the files the export created. Exported copies are user-managed and are not recalled by note deletion; the note-derived managed transform artifacts are purged with the note.
expected: pre-existing main + sibling -> main replaced, sibling byte-identical, copies under free names
failure after the first copy -> ok False, tree byte-identical
destination symlink -> link replaced, target intact
markerless live attachment -> not copied, unreferenced_attachments 1

T01.title: Autosave timer run-loop mode
T01.decision: The autosave timer is registered in NSRunLoopCommonModes (default, modal panel and event tracking): a typed tail still saves while a menu or a modal panel is open. The tick only reads the model and starts an owned worker thread. The editor invalidates the timer at shutdown.
expected: typed tail committed by running the ordinary default-mode run loop, without calling autosave_tick

E01.title: Optional note evidence completeness
E01.decision: Note evidence is optional and consent-gated. A callback failure never rolls back the note revision and is reported as training.note_capture_failed. The evidence writer admits an observation only for a live revision of a live note, and records one observation per (revision, kind) within the envelope's retained window (32 entries). A crash between a revision commit and its callback is NOT reconciled: that observation is missing, and this is a documented limitation, not a promise.
expected: late callback after deletion -> no open link
redelivered event -> observation count unchanged
failed callback -> revision committed, failure event emitted

U01.title: Admitted mutations with unknown outcome
U01.decision: A store call that timed out after admission is 'unknown': it may still commit. Note creation, restore and attachments carry preallocated identities (the later read reconciles; a retried append with the same revision id is one logical effect); pin is idempotent; delete is idempotent. Status lines say pending/unknown, never failed; only a proven noncommit is 'failed'; an admission refusal ('store is closing') is 'not done'. History Move never deletes after an unknown note creation (outcome create_unknown).
expected: held writer + short caller wait on Pin/New -> status without 'failed'
Move with unknown create -> source job kept

S01.title: Snapshot during a running autosave
S01.decision: Snapshot is a barrier for the generation current at the click. When an autosave already committed that generation, no second revision is written and the status says everything is already saved; the committed revision keeps the autosave trigger (an autosave never claims to be explicit, and an explicit request that found nothing new does not relabel it).
expected: Snapshot while autosave A is held and B typed -> at return B is committed or the status says pending

X01.title: Attachment marker removal
X01.decision: The Hub has no attachment-removal action. Removing a marker by typing is an ordinary typed revision: the attachment stays live and owned (retained until the note is deleted) and is reported as unreferenced by export. Payload deletion happens only with the note, through post-commit purge intents.
expected: marker typed away -> payload readable, export unreferenced_attachments 1

L01.title: History transfer resolution
L01.decision: History copy/move resolves the row through the same detail History displays (job_detail, legacy_detail, legacy_db_detail) and the one final_text rule: the applied transform output of the current attempt, else its cleaned output; a missing final stage is refused, never replaced by an earlier stage. The Hub passes the sha256 of the text it shows; a changed row is refused (history_changed). Legacy rows copy their cleaned text as typed-origin notes; Move on a legacy row degrades to copy.
expected: distinct raw/cleaned/transform + retained older attempt -> note = current attempt's transform output
purged transform output -> no note
legacy_db / legacy_log rows -> cleaned text copied, move degrades

M12-AUDIT-01.evidence: base: the outside sentinel was read through ../ traversal, an absolute path and a directory/final symlink, a FIFO read blocked, and delete_attachment/delete_note unlinked the outside sentinel

M12-AUDIT-02.evidence: base: a third-write failure unlinked two pre-existing files; a chmod failure left the pre-existing main file replaced; export wrote through a destination symlink; an unapproved sibling was overwritten

M12-AUDIT-03.evidence: base: a failed (or held-then-failed) outgoing save discarded the only newest tail on switch

M12-AUDIT-04.evidence: base: the dictated span covered the typed word 'one' (the audit's exact witness)

M12-AUDIT-05.evidence: base: a rolled-back delete left live rows with their payload unlinked; a failed unlink left the payload with no durable pending purge

M12-AUDIT-06.evidence: base: a deleted note gained a live attachment; a timed-out caller's cleanup unlinked the payload of a row that then committed; a crash after the write left an unowned payload

M12-AUDIT-07.evidence: base: insertion_confirmed and a confirmed usage fact while the revision was held; confirmed after a failed save; transform_applied before the revision committed

M12-AUDIT-08.evidence: base: Snapshot reported saved while generation B was uncommitted; quit closed the store under admitted note work; close during a flush dropped generation B

M12-AUDIT-09.evidence: base: arrival A's provenance was replaced by B's; a failed A restored its pending over B's identity

M12-AUDIT-10.evidence: base: the timer registered under the literal 'default' mode never fired while the ordinary default-mode run loop ran (typed autosave never ran through the installed timer)

M12-AUDIT-11.evidence: base: Pin and Delete acted on the selected, unrendered note; Add Image attached to A and put the marker in B

M12-AUDIT-12.evidence: base: with 'A😀B' and the native caret at UTF-16 3 the dictation landed after B

M12-AUDIT-13.evidence: base: a whole-note capture of 'alpha' accepted after the note grew, replacing the prefix

M12-AUDIT-14.evidence: base: the transfer copied a stale cleaned artifact instead of the current attempt's transform output, and substituted an earlier stage for a purged final

M12-AUDIT-15.evidence: base: note-derived candidate artifacts survived note deletion; a late record_candidate recreated a deleted note's text

M12-AUDIT-16.evidence: base: a late callback reopened a deleted note's evidence link; a redelivered event added a second observation

M12-AUDIT-17.evidence: base: after deleting the dictated first 'echo', the surviving typed 'echo' kept the dictated span

M12-AUDIT-18.evidence: base: an older save cleared the unsaved marker while generation B was unsaved

M12-AUDIT-19.evidence: base: the private pasteboard's change count moved on a refused note dictation and on a refused note transform

M12-AUDIT-20.evidence: base: the Move selector raised AttributeError

M12-AUDIT-21.evidence: base: Export .txt and Delete lay outside the pane at the default size, five actions at the minimum size

M12-AUDIT-22.evidence: base: seven malformed native ranges were clamped into neighbouring slices

M12-AUDIT-23.evidence: base: the chosen transform and version reset on refresh

M12-AUDIT-24.evidence: base: Pin/New reported failed for admitted-unknown writes; History Move reported create_failed for an unknown creation

M12-AUDIT-25.evidence: base: the '10,000-word' fixture had 11,250 words and the benchmark had no work-validity oracle; its acknowledgment timer wrapped a synchronous flush

M12-AUDIT-26.evidence: base: two fields of the historical M12 results held the absolute repository path (field names only recorded)

LOCAL-M12-01.title: History transfer of legacy rows raised
LOCAL-M12-01.evidence: base: hubSaveHistoryRow converted History's legacy key ('legacy-db:N' or an artifact id) with int(), so the real legacy Copy/Move raised

LOCAL-M12-02.title: A populated Scratchpad table lost at open was recreated empty
LOCAL-M12-02.evidence: base: dropping notes, note_revisions or note_attachments from a populated store and reopening opened it as intact with the table empty

LOCAL-M12-03.title: Identical version labels collapse the versions popup
LOCAL-M12-03.evidence: base and first pass: NSPopUpButton.addItemWithTitle_ drops an item whose title exists, so autosaves in one second with equal word counts showed 2 items for 4 revisions and Restore used a different revision than the one chosen (found by corpus probe LF-M12-S006)

LF-M12-S013.delete_after_unlink_before_commit: structural: no unlink precedes the commit in the repaired design (post-commit purge intents); the probe fails the commit itself (delete_before_commit)

LF-M12-S014.note_delete_after_unlink_before_commit: structural: no unlink precedes the commit in the repaired design (post-commit purge intents); the probe fails the commit itself (note_delete_before_commit)

LF-M12-S025.after_content_read_before_pending_read: structural: the buffer and the arrival are captured under one lock (no separate pending read exists); the probe holds a captured arrival's persistence (A_captured)
